s: Nix and NixOS offer reproducible system management and software development, enabling effortless environment sharing and eliminating 'it works on my machine' issues. The article details configuring a NixOS system and creating reproducible Python data science environments using flakes.
sub: Reproducible Python development environments with Flakes
Integrating Ollama and NVIDIA CUDA with Nix
Managing Python dependencies via pip within Nix environments
